In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we are not yet able to provide a fully automated recommendation system, but we can provide useful suggestions for some users in some segments.
we have not yet reached a level of machine translation quality where it can be recommended to translators with confidence.
the TTE estimation is a promising approach for the estimation of translation quality, which can be used to improve the quality of machine translation output recommendations in a CAT environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found a promising approach for using the TTE metric to estimate the quality of MT output.
we have developed a framework for predicting the time to edit a machine translated segment.

we have shown that it is possible to predict TTE with a reasonable accuracy and we believe that the prediction of TTE is an important step towards a recommendation system for machine translation output.
The main takeaway from our work is that
machine translation suggestions can be useful in a CAT environment, but the usefulness of a suggestion is dependent on the translator's experience and familiarity with the text.

machine translation can be useful for translators in a CAT environment, and that a combination of content filtering and machine translation output estimation can be used to determine when it is useful.
